summary: This bill requires hospitals receiving Medicare payments for graduate medical education to report de-identified information on the citizenship status of their medical residents to the Secretary of Health and Human Services, who will then report this data to Congress.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Social Security Act concerning Medicare payments for graduate medical education. It requires hospitals receiving these payments to report on the citizenship status of medical residents, making it directly related to the administration and funding of medical training within the healthcare system.

The bill mandates reporting on the citizenship status of medical residents, including categories for U.S. citizens, permanent residents, and various non-immigrant visa holders. This directly involves tracking and categorizing individuals based on their immigration status within a specific sector.
